publication_method: Every Git blob was checked against locally computed Git object SHA; a separate directory/tree read at the committed SHA then checked all346 selected readable files and archive parts. This receipt is an additive child commit, outside the archive to avoid self-reference.
operational_note: An initial large create_tree request timed out before any commit; tree construction was retried in40-file batches, then committed once and independently read back. This did not change any scientific artifact.
